AVX-512 ChaCha RNG refill logic for 8- and 20-round variants.

# Purpose
This C file implements AVX-512 refill routines for a ChaCha-based random number generator. The main function, [`fd_chacha_rng_refill_avx512`](<#fd_chacha_rng_refill_avx512>), reads the generator key and current buffer state from `fd_chacha_rng_t`, builds the ChaCha state with the fixed constants, key words, and block index, then runs the ChaCha round function with SIMD operations. It uses a 16-lane vector layout, applies the quarter-round steps with `wwu_add`, `wwu_xor`, and rotate helpers, and then transposes the result so the generated words can be stored into the output ring buffer.

The file also defines two public refill entry points, [`fd_chacha8_rng_refill_avx512`](<#fd_chacha8_rng_refill_avx512>) and [`fd_chacha20_rng_refill_avx512`](<#fd_chacha20_rng_refill_avx512>), which call the shared refill function with 4 or 10 double-rounds. These functions provide the AVX-512 implementations for ChaCha8 and ChaCha20 output generation, and they update the buffer fill count after writing 16 ChaCha blocks into `rng->buf`.
